title: The Vast plain of the north
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：vast　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vast 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the keeper wrote of ① a vast plain of the north in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② vaster than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the vast ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the vastest plain of the north anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too vast to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the vast ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a vast difference between them, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as vast as the difference between them they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was vast or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something vast, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite vast; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the vast ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, at once, she wrote of another vast plain of the north in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ vaster than anybody had expected. ⑩ The vastest difference between them in the whole zoo, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the vast ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 辽阔（前置定语 a vast plain of the north：1988 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件辽阔的平原）
B. adj. 辽阔／巨大（比较级 vaster than：文中两处，一处比北方辽阔的平原，一处比预想）
C. adj. 辽阔／巨大（最高级 the vastest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 辽阔（表语 too vast to do：母亲觉得它太辽阔，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 巨大（前置定语 a vast difference between them：叔叔把整件事称作一桩巨大的差别）
F. adj. 巨大（同级比较 as vast as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩两人之间的巨大差别相比）
G. adj. 巨大（后置定语 something vast：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 巨大（受程度副词修饰 quite vast：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a vast plain of the north
the vastest plain of the north anybody
The vastest difference between them in

answers.why: vast 意为“辽阔”，1988 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件辽阔的平原”，此处作前置定语 a vast plain of the north。
vast 意为“辽阔”，此处用比较级 vaster than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
vast 意为“辽阔”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最辽阔的一件，故用最高级 the vastest plain of the north。
vast 意为“辽阔”，母亲认为这件东西“太辽阔了，谁也用不上”，too vast to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
vast 意为“巨大”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩巨大的差别”，此处作前置定语 a vast difference between them。
vast 意为“巨大”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩两人之间的巨大差别一样巨大”，同级比较用 as vast as。
vast 意为“巨大”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“巨大的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something vast。
vast 意为“巨大”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当巨大”，quite 修饰原级 vast。
vast 意为“巨大”，1998 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要巨大”，故用比较级 vaster than。
vast 意为“巨大”，母亲 2000 年说的是“整个兽舍里最巨大的那一桩”，故用最高级 the vastest difference between them。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件辽阔的平原。（a vast plain of the north）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更辽阔。（vaster than …）
母亲觉得它太辽阔，谁也用不上。（too vast to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩巨大的差别。（a vast difference between them）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩两人之间的巨大差别一样巨大。（as vast as …）
到了 1995 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件巨大的东西。（something vast）
answers: In 1988 the keeper wrote of a vast plain of the north in the register.
Everybody said it was vaster than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too vast to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a vast difference between them.
He said nobody would call it as vast as the difference between them they had once had.
By 1995 the register asked for nothing but something vast.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 vast 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the keeper wrote of a vast plain of the north in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the vastest plain of the north in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too vast to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a vast difference between them, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite vast, and everybody laughed.
The vast ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
